meta.title: DR In Sync at a Restore Point

views.label: WAL path
views.note: Every instance archives its own WAL into a per-content directory; every DR node restores from the same directory.

views.label: Restore point
views.note: gp_create_restore_point('N') writes one XLOG_RESTORE_POINT record into every instance's WAL.

views.label: Replica paused
views.note: Each DR node replays until the record named by gp_pause_on_restore_point_replay and pauses exactly there.

cards.title: What 'in sync' means
items: Every node has replayed to the same named restore point and paused there — that is the servable cut
gp_pause_on_restore_point_replay matches the XLOG_RESTORE_POINT record by exact name
At the pause the startup process freezes a local snapshot; gg_dr_switch later publishes it cluster-wide

cards.title: DR mode is a predicate
items: IsDRReplicaMode() = hot_standby AND in recovery — no GUC or signal file to unset at promote
ggdr create arms it: hot_standby=on, standby.signal, restore_command, gg_topology_source=file

cards.title: Archive and replay discipline
items: %c expands to the content id — one archive dir per content; the coordinator is seg-1/
Mirrors and standby need archive_command preset: a node in recovery archives nothing
WAL replays in full (no redo filter); the replica never connects to production — RPO is the cut's age
